result.summary: The page is generally polished, but a few layout and readability issues are visible, mainly around fixed navigation overlap, clipped horizontal content, and low-contrast promotional text.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the second restaurant promotion card, cutting off its image and content instead of leaving adequate scroll space beneath it.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable page equal to the bottom navigation height plus safe-area spacing, or ensure the content scrolls fully above the navigation.

issues.description: The category chip row and the fastest-near-you restaurant carousel are visibly cut off at the right edge, with partial chips/cards shown without an obvious horizontal-scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scrolling indicators, partially reveal the next item intentionally with consistent spacing, or provide a more explicit carousel interaction.

issues.description: The white promotional text in the pale green banner has relatively low contrast, especially the smaller subtitle.
issues.suggestion: Darken the text or use a stronger background overlay/color so all banner copy meets accessible contrast requirements.
